You summoned me so urgently, I thought something serious had happened.
Nothing serious. I called because there's something I need you to do for me.
strings.요즘 울이 통 무슨 생각을 하는지 전혀 알 수 없어서 그걸 좀 알아봐 주: Lately I have no idea what Ull is thinking. I'd like you to look into it.
strings.요즘 들어 울과 꽤 친하다고 생각되는 사람은 모험가님밖에 없는 것 같아서: You seem to be the only person he's become reasonably close to recently, Adventurer.
Does crossing paths on a few jobs really make us close...?
strings.알아봐 주시면 사례를 하겠습니다. 역시 돈을 드리면 움직이시겠죠?: I will compensate you for investigating. Money should motivate you, shouldn't it?
strings.그럼 다녀오겠습니다. 그런데 대충 어떤 이야길 하면 될까요?: Then I'll go. But what should I ask him about?
strings.울이 강해지기 위해 수련을 열심히 하는 편이긴 하지만, 최근 들어 욕심이: Ull has always trained hard to grow stronger, but lately his ambition seems to have grown.
strings.그 아이는 늘 한계를 넘어왔어요. 그 자체를 즐기고 있죠. 아, 이 이야: He has always pushed beyond his limits. He enjoys doing so. Well, that's enough about it. I'm counting on you.
What are you doing here? Come to bother me again? Get lost.
I'm telling you to mind your own business.
strings.보나 마나 걱정 많은 첫째 사저께서 네 녀석을 보내셨겠지?: Let me guess. Our ever-worried eldest senior sent you.
strings.뻔하지. 다른 사형 사저들은 나한테 전~혀 신경 쓰지 않는데, 첫째 사저: It's obvious. My other seniors pay me no attention at all. Only she worries. Probably because so much has happened lately.
strings.내가 아무리 날고 기어도 첫째 사저를 벗어날 수가 없더군. 내가 있는 곳: No matter what I do, I can't escape her. She finds me so easily...
strings.마치 여신님 손바닥 안이랄까. 항상 날 보고 욕심부리지 말라 그랬는데,: It's like being in the goddess' palm. She's always telling me not to be greedy. But I...
strings.자고로 검을 들었다면 영감탱, 아니 스승님처럼 반열에 올라야 한다 생각하: If you take up the sword, you should aspire to the same heights as that old geezer—my master.
I think you just called him an old geezer...
strings.달린 귀가 아주 쓸모없진 않은가 봐? 이런 것도 그대로 듣는 걸 보면 말: Those ears aren't completely useless, then. You caught even that.
strings.반열에 오르고 싶다고? 초인이 되고 싶은 거야?: The same heights? You want to become a Champion?
strings.초인이란 실력과 경험을 통해 어느 정도의 반열에 오른 사람. 난 그 목표: A Champion is someone who has reached a certain level through skill and experience. That's what I'm training for.
No new Champion has appeared on this continent for centuries.
strings.스승님을 비롯해 초인 일곱 명만이 계속해서 초인이라는 이름을 유지하고 있: Only the seven Champions, including my master, have continued to bear that title.
strings.슬슬 다음 세대의 초인이 나타날 때가 된 것 같지 않아? 누군가 다음 초: Isn't it about time the next generation appeared? If someone's going to become the next Champion, I want it to be me.
Yuran already knows all this. That's enough.
strings.울에겐 좀 더 강해져야만 하는 그런 이유가 있나 보네. 지금도 무척 강한: He must have a reason he needs to grow stronger. He already seems incredibly powerful... A Champion...
strings.(울과 했던 이야기를 유란에게 전달한다. 영감탱이라고 했던 것도 모두 포: (You recount your conversation with Ull to Yuran, including his reference to the 'old geezer.')
The same as ever. Even calling Master an old geezer.
strings.스승님께서는 항상 자만하지 말라고 말씀하셨죠. 그러다 보면 그게 언젠가: Master always tells us not to grow conceited. Someday, that pride may tighten around our own throats.
I hope you never put a noose around your own neck, Adventurer.
strings.모험가님께선 초인에 대해 어떻게 생각하시나요?: What do you think of Champions, Adventurer?
strings.초인이요? 저는 생각해 본 적도 별로 없고 그냥 지나가다 들은 게 전부지: Champions? I've hardly thought about them. I've only heard things in passing... They seem like extraordinary people.
strings.이 대륙엔 스승님과 같은 초인들이 여섯 명 더 있습니다. 이스트랜드에선: There are six other Champions like my master on this continent. In Eastland, they are called the Seven Great Champions.
strings.강력한 능력으로 인간의 위에 선 자들. 그렇다고 해서 이리스 님처럼 신은: Beings who stand above humans through their immense power, yet are not gods like Lady Iris.
strings.많은 경험과 높은 실력을 갖추면 어떤 반열에 오르게 된다고 합니다. 그: They say great experience and skill can lift someone to that level. The standard differs for each person.
strings.헤, 신기하군요. 울은 초인이 되고 싶어 하던데, 유란님은 어떠세요? 유: That's fascinating. Ull wants to become one. What about you, Yuran? I've heard you're an incredible swordswoman.
strings.차라리 저주를 받겠습니다. 실례했습니다. 방금 이야기는 듣지 않은 거로: I would sooner be cursed. Forgive me. Please forget I said that.
strings.(뭐지, 순간 표정이 굳었는데…?): (What was that? Her face went rigid for a moment...)
strings.모험가님, 혹시 배달 의뢰 하나 맡아서 해보실 생각 없으신가요?: Adventurer, would you be interested in a delivery commission?
What, all of a sudden? I'd like a little rest...
strings.이 정도 사례는 되겠습니까? 의뢰한 쪽에서 꼭 찝어 모험가님이면 좋겠다고: Would this payment suffice? The client specifically requested you.
If they asked for me, I'll go.
strings.쥬드 왕국 동부 국경지대의 바질 영주님께 가시면 됩니다. 어, 벌써 가셨: Visit Lord Basil in the eastern borderlands of the Kingdom of Jude. Oh, gone already...
strings.(당신이 그 힘에 관심을 두지 않았으면 좋겠군요. 하지만 그게 원하지 않: (I hope you take no interest in that power. But simply not wanting it does not mean it will pass you by...)
It's you. I haven't seen you since that incident. You seem a little stronger.
It's been a while, my lord.
strings.내가 자네를 부른 까닭은 이 물건 때문이지. 이걸 벨파 도서관의 사서들에: I called you because of these items. Take them to the librarians at Belpa Library.
An artifact and a grimoire found while clearing the Sun God's Underground Altar.
strings.쥬드 왕국은 지금 이 물건을 해석할 여유가 없네. 파괴된 수도를 복구하는: The Kingdom of Jude has no time to decipher them now. Nothing is more important than rebuilding our devastated capital.
strings.그래서 이 물건이 어울리는 곳에 보내기로 했네. 재건에 도움을 준 벨파: So I've decided to send them somewhere suitable. Belpa Library helped with the reconstruction. They will put these to proper use.
strings.솔직히 마법서에 대해선 내가 잘 모르지만, 안에 있는 삽화는 마치 조부께: To be honest, I know little of grimoires. But its illustrations resemble the ancient Champion stories my grandfather told me.
You seem to have heard a great deal about them.
strings.네. 동방 대륙에 와서 이야기를 들은 것도 있지만, 유난히 오늘따라 많이: Yes. I've heard stories since coming to the eastern continent, but especially many today.
strings.하하하, 그런가? 그럼 지겹겠군. 나는 그 이야긴 하지 않겠네. 서둘러: Hahaha, have you? Then you must be tired of them. I won't add to it. Take these to Belpa Library quickly.
strings.제단에서 발견된 아티팩트라는 이야기가 새면 데이모스 교단이나 모스 왕국에: If word gets out that artifacts were found at the altar, the Deimos Order or the Kingdom of Mos may try to claim them. Do be careful.
strings.바쁘다. 바빠. 어라, 모험가님? 오랜만이에요!!: Busy, busy. Oh, Adventurer? It's been so long!
strings.(가져온 물건을 펠에게 보여주며 이곳에 오게 된 이유를 설명한다.): (You show Pel the items you brought and explain why you have come.)
I see. So that really was all. Dull...
An artifact and grimoire from the eastern continent? Fascinating. Wait a moment.
strings.초인! 초인! 이전 세대 초인에 대한 이야기!!진짜 대단한 이야기에요!!: A Champion! A Champion! The story of a Champion from a previous age! This is incredible! Adventurer, are you interested in Champions?
strings.종교인 같은 말씀을 하시네요. 요즘 초인에 대해서 정말 많이 듣네요. 살: You sound like you're preaching. I've been hearing so much about Champions lately. I am getting a little curious.
That's wonderful to hear. Listen closely, then.
strings.모험가님. 이런 아티팩트는 자격을 가진 존재를 찾는 경우가 많아요. 보세: Adventurer, artifacts like this often seek someone worthy. Look. It's responding to you.
strings.이건 '오브 패널'. 여러 개의 오브들이 박혀 있는 판…. 특정 조건,: This is an 'Orb Panel.' A panel set with several orbs... When certain conditions are met, certain qualifications gained, the dark orbs will light up...
strings.그러면 전부 빛이 나면 봉인이 풀려서 자격을 가진 자에게 들어가는 건가요: So once they all light up, the seal breaks and the power passes to the worthy person?
strings.아무래도 모험가님이 자격이 되는 것 같아요. 이 패널에 있는 마력 일부가: You seem to be qualified, Adventurer. Some of the panel's magic is responding to you.
strings.책을 살펴보니 위험한 힘은 아닌 것 같아요. 악을 처단하기 위해 정의로운: From the book, the power doesn't seem dangerous. It's about a boy who became a Champion with a righteous heart to defeat evil.
strings.지금의 모험가님에게 어울리는 힘일지도 모르겠어요. 지금까지 이 세계의 위: It may be a fitting power for you now. You've saved this world whenever danger threatened.
Adventurer, this power already seems to want to go to you.
strings.이 오브의 힘을 얻는다면 초인이 되는 건가요?: If I gain the orbs' power, will I become a Champion?
You'll simply gain a new power and grow a little stronger... Don't expect too much.
strings.헤에, 많이 부담스러웠는데…. 그냥 조금이라면 괜찮겠죠. 다른 사람들을: Oh, that sounded like a heavy burden... But a little stronger should be all right. If it helps me help others...
strings.잘 생각하셨어요. 이걸로 첫 번째 패널이 개방된 것 같아요! 자격을 갖춘: A wise choice. I think the first panel has opened! The resolve of a worthy person must be a key to opening it!
strings.두 번째 패널부터는 제가 해석한 대로 해당 지역으로 가서 움직이시면 될: For the second panel onward, follow my interpretation of the book and visit the places it describes. The grimoire seems to want that too...
Wait... I thought this book only contained a story... Apparently not...
strings.소년이 어떤 기술을 지녔고, 어떻게 수련하는지 적혀 있는 걸 보니 교본이: It describes the boy's techniques and how he trained. It must be a manual too. Amazing.
strings.이 오브의 힘이 없어서 따라 해도 사용할 수 없는 것 같군요…. 어쩔 수: Without the power of these orbs, copying the techniques won't work... We have no choice but to follow the boy's footsteps as the book describes.
strings.책에 의하면 소년은 프레이오스의 어떤 신비한 땅의 영주에게 실력으로 인정: According to the book, the boy proved his skill to the lord of a mysterious land in Freios. But this castle... Where is it?
strings.고마워, 리즈. 모험가님, 그곳에서 '영주의 증표'를 발견한다면 가져오세: Thank you, Liz. Adventurer, if you find the 'Lord's Token' there, bring it here. I'll see whether the panel responds.
strings.이게 소년이 영주에게 인정받아서 얻었다던 증표…, 오브 패널의 오브가 반: So this is the token the boy received when the lord acknowledged him... The Orb Panel is reacting.
But the token seems corrupted. The orb can't absorb its power properly.
I'll find another item while you work.
strings.잠시만요. 책을 좀 더 해석해 드릴게요. 어디 보자…, 마법사가 소년에게: Wait. Let me decipher a little more. Let's see... A mage seems to have suggested that the boy become a Champion.
strings.소년은 동방대륙의 평화를 위해 받아들였고, 수련했어요. 영주에게 인정받았: The boy accepted and trained for the peace of the eastern continent. After earning the lord's recognition... Ah, here!
strings.엘프들이 머무는 신성한 땅, 그곳에 있는 녹지 않는 얼음? 그런 곳이 어: A sacred land where elves dwell, and ice that never melts? Where could that be?
strings.현재는 악마의 협곡으로 변한 곳이군요. 한때는 하이엘프들이 머물며 신의: The place now known as Devil's Canyon. High elves once lived there and sang the gods' blessings...
strings.모험가님…. 아직도 그곳을 어지럽히는 무리가 있으니…. 그곳의 정리도 함: Adventurer... Some creatures still disturb that place... Please deal with them as well.
strings.괜찮았어요. 여기 도구 드릴게요. 다음 이야기는 어떻게 되나요? 생각보다: It was fine. Here's the item. What happens next? This is more interesting than I expected.
strings.그럼 바로 알려드릴게요. 마법사는 소년에게 세레스 여신의 신전에서 기도하: I'll tell you right away. The mage told the boy to pray in Goddess Seres' temple, fill a cup with holy water, and drink it to receive her blessing.
strings.아까부터 궁금했던 건데, 그 마법사는 누구지…?: I've been wondering... Who is this mage?
strings.리즈, 나도 전혀 모르겠어…. 도서관에 있는 책 수만 권을 읽었지만, 전: I don't know at all, Liz... I've read tens of thousands of books in this library, but no one comes to mind.
strings.다음에 가셔야 할 장소가 정해졌네요. 신전의 성스러운 회당으로 가셔야 할: We know your next destination now. The temple's Holy Assembly Hall.
strings.주의하셔야 할 점이 있어요…. 모험가님이 새 힘을 얻는 과정엔 언제나 방: There is something to watch for... Whenever you gain new power, there will be those who obstruct you...
strings.그들은 본의가 아닐지라도… 부정한 기운이 몰려들어서 모험가님에게 달려들겠: Even against their own will... Unclean energy may gather and drive them to attack you...
There will be obstacles before the temple as well... Defeat them.
strings.떠난 지 얼마 되지 않은 것 같은데, 벌써 다녀오셨군요…. 파괴의 신이: You seem to have left only a moment ago, yet you're already back... If there were a god of destruction, you would suit the role...
Liz, that's rude. Keep those thoughts to yourself.
All right... To myself, to myself...
strings.시간이 좀 걸리긴 했지만, 가져오신 도구를 모두 정화했어요. 자, 이렇게: It took some time, but we've purified all the items you brought. Now, if I do this...
strings.(펠이 살며시 손을 흔들자 패널 앞에 있던 재료들이 빛나기 시작한다.): (As Pel gently waves a hand, the materials before the panel begin to glow.)
...The items you collected are all traces of the past. Lingering thoughts made visible...
The thoughts within those items have entered your panel as you follow the boy's traces.
strings.그럼 앞으로 4개 남았고, 도구는 얼마나 더 모아야 하는 거죠?: Four left, then. How many more items do I need?
strings.마법서를 계속 해석해야겠지만, 일단은 여덟 개 정도가 더 필요할 것 같아: I'll have to keep deciphering the grimoire, but it looks like about eight more for now.
strings.에…, 쥬드 왕국 수도인 것 같아요. 마법사와 함께 소년은 쥬드 왕국을: Um... The capital of the Kingdom of Jude, I think. 'Together with the mage, the boy fought the forces of darkness attacking the kingdom...'
strings.쥬드 왕국 국왕에게 인정받은 소년은 태양신의 눈물로 만들어진 태양의 증표: 'Recognized by the King of Jude, the boy received the Token of the Sun, made from the Sun God's tears...' That's what it says.
The token is probably... inside the palace.
strings.헛, 모험가님. 벌써 가셨네. 급하셔라. 리즈, 리즈는 이해가 돼? 이: Oh! Gone already. Always in such a hurry. Liz, do you understand why this mage appeared to the boy?
strings.잘 모르겠어…. 아직 잘 모르겠어…. 밝혀낼 게 많아서 더 흥미로운 게: I'm not sure... Not yet... Perhaps having so much to uncover makes it more interesting...?
strings.그건 그렇긴 해. 좀 더 확인해 봐야겠어. 초인에 대한 거니 좀 더 중요: That's true. We should investigate further. It's about a Champion. Surely there's something more important to come? Hehe.
strings.펠…. 이 책에 초인의 힘을 쓰는 방법 나와 있잖아. 잘 보니 지금 7대: Pel... This book explains how to use Champion powers. Looking closely, aren't these the techniques of the current Seven Great Champions?
strings.흐음…. 그러면 그 소년은 모든 초인의 기술을 다 쓸 수 있었다는 건가?: Hmm... Does that mean the boy could use every Champion's techniques?
I've brought the book you requested... 'The Prince's Secret Seduction'...
strings.저, 저기!! 조용히 말씀해 주세요!! 심부름으로 온 거지만, 부끄럽다구: Um, excuse me!! Please keep your voice down! I'm only running an errand, but it's embarrassing!
It's all right, Platina. We respect your tastes. We welcome variety here.
strings.도서관이 꽤 시끄럽네…. 어라, 플라티나 씨?: The library is rather noisy... Oh, Platina?
strings.와, 반가워요!! 플라티나 씨, 도서관엔 웬일이에요? 그 책은 뭐죠? ': Good to see you! What brings you to the library, Platina? What's that book? 'The Prince's Secret...'?
strings.아하하하, 아무것도 아니에요. 폐하께서 책을 한 권 찾아오라고 하셨거든요: Ahahaha, nothing at all. Her Majesty asked me to find a book. Ahahaha... No, more than one. Ahahaha.
I'll go look for some other books for a moment. Please take care, Adventurer. Ahahahaha!
See you next time. Pel, I brought the item.
I'll prepare to purify it right away. Now, here's the next passage I've deciphered.
strings.쥬드 왕국의 국왕은 소년에게 감사하며 태양신 아그니의 가호를 받을 수 있: 'In gratitude to the boy, the King of Jude held a rite so he might receive the protection of Agni, the Sun God...'
This time... You'll need to visit the Sun God's Underground Altar.
strings.아, 바로 다녀올 걸 그랬나?: Oh, should I have gone straight there?
strings.아직 뒷 내용을 알지 못하니까 헛걸음하면 어떻게 하시려구요?: We didn't know what came next. What if you'd made a wasted trip?
strings.그럴 수도 있겠군요. 그냥 순순히 왔다 갔다 하겠습니다. 후우, 그럼 다: That's true. I'll just go back and forth as instructed. Sigh. I'll be back, then.
strings.듣기에 지하제단을 어지럽히는 무리도 있다니…. 적당히 날뛰셔도 될 것 같: I hear there are still creatures disturbing the underground altar... Feel free to make a little trouble for them...
strings.폐하께서 말씀하신 그대로야. 새로운 신을 돕는 준비가 어려울 거라 하셨는: Exactly as Her Majesty said. She warned that preparing to help a new god would be difficult. This is that very process...
I can only hope those people don't find out... Sigh...
strings.수고하셨어요. 세 번째 패널을 개방할 수 있을 것 같아요. 잠시만 기다리: Well done. I think we can open the third panel now. Just a moment.
I still can't feel any power from it.
You will probably feel it once all the panels are open...
strings.리즈, 방금 그 짜잔~은 뭐야?: Liz, what was that 'ta-da' just now?
Oh, I see... Adventurer, your next destination is... Here.
strings.…마법사는 말했다. 소년이 폭포나무 숲으로 갔으면 좋겠다고. 자연의 순수: 'The mage spoke. He wished the boy to visit Waterfall Tree Forest. Nature's pure essence would cleanse evil...'
It seems to say that receiving this 'pure essence' would help.
strings.…마법사는 마치 다 알고 있는 것 같네요. 그나저나 폭포나무 숲이면 협곡: ...The mage seems to know everything. Waterfall Tree Forest is in the canyon, isn't it?
strings.소문에 의하면…. 아직도 화이트 콜 협곡에 럭스의 부대원들이 몇몇 남아: Rumor has it... Some of Lux's troops still remain in White Col Canyon...
I'll deal with them while I'm there. A little exercise won't hurt.
strings.성격 참 급하셔. 벌써 가셨네. 있잖아, 리즈. 이 책에 나온 기술들 말: Always in such a hurry. Gone already. You know, Liz, don't the techniques in this book resemble those of the gods in mythology?
strings.초인의 힘…. 신들의 힘과 같은 거라 말하고 싶은 거야…?: Champion powers... You mean they are the same as the gods' powers...?
strings.우리가 지식의 신 레다님의 힘을 이어받은 거랑 마찬가지 아닐까?: Could it be like how we inherited the power of Leda, God of Knowledge?
But that would mean the boy gained access to a portion of every god's power.
I've brought the book you requested. 'The Handsome Minister's Holiday'...
Again, it's not for me. Her Majesty sent me on an errand... Ahahaha...
strings.그냥 한 번에 다 빌려가시는 건 어떠신가요? 실바리아 제국이라면 얼마든지: Why not borrow them all at once? We can certainly trust the Silvaria Empire with our books.
strings.'발칙한 집사와 아련한 도련님', '청소만 하는 게 아니라구요, 메이드씨: How about 'The Brazen Butler and His Wistful Young Master,' 'There's More to Me Than Cleaning, Dear Maid,' or 'The Little Knight and the Older Lady'...?
strings.으아아아아, 그, 그만요! 그런 부끄러운 제목을 사서님의 정확한 발음으로: Aaaaaah! S-stop! Please don't read those embarrassing titles in your perfectly clear librarian's voice!
Platina, borrowing those sorts of books again?
strings.…그, 그런 책이라뇨!! 아, 사실이긴 하지. 변명해 봐야 부질없는 건가: ...Th-those sorts of books?! Oh, well, that's true. No use making excuses. Sigh. I'll go browse the technical books...
Hehe. Teasing her is rather fun.
Liz, Pel. I brought the item.
strings.이 도구는 정말 신기하네요. 오래전 사념일 뿐인데, 당장이라도 정화할 수: This is remarkable. It's only a lingering thought from long ago, yet enough energy remains to purify something even now...
...Still, it is only a tool for opening the panel.
True. Oh, Adventurer, I'll tell you where to go next.
strings.이쯤 되면 보석나무 숲인가요?: At this point, Jewel Tree Forest?
strings.딩동댕이 너무 음침하지 않아요?: Isn't that a little gloomy for a correct-answer chime?
strings.그런 건 신경 쓰지 마시고 다음 이야길 들어보세요. 어디 보자 여기…,: Never mind that. Listen to the next part. Let's see... 'Because of the ancient dragon Gluart, the mage...'
Gluart... I think I've heard that name somewhere...
strings.욕심 많던 동방 대륙의 드래곤…. 사람들에게 큰 피해를 줬었는데, 지스카: A greedy dragon of the eastern continent... He caused great harm to people, until Ziskad defeated him upon becoming a Champion.
strings.이 책엔 마을 사람들이 피해를 본다면서 마법사가 소년에게 글루아트를 만나: In this book, the mage tells the boy that villagers are suffering and asks him to meet Gluart.
strings.소년의 용기에 감화됐는지 글루아트가 사람들을 괴롭히지 않겠다고 약속까지: Moved by the boy's courage, perhaps, Gluart promised not to torment people and gave him a Tear of Light made from a jewel.
strings.책 내용을 알아가면서 느낀 건데, 그 소년의 정의로운 모습은 마치 저를: The more I learn about this boy's righteous deeds, the more he reminds me of myself.
strings.알았어요. 알았어요. 그냥 해본 소린데, 그렇게 정색할 줄이야….그럼 다: All right, all right. I was only joking. I didn't expect such stony looks... I'll be going. Sniff. You're so mean!
strings.가시는 길에 아직도 폭포나무 숲을 어지럽히는 존재들이 있다고 하니…. 벌: There are still creatures disturbing Waterfall Tree Forest on the way... Gone already... Perhaps that goes without saying...
So this is the 'Tear of Light' Gluart gave the boy... Brilliant and beautiful.
That was truly instantaneous... To think even the fourth panel would be so easy...
Thank you for all your hard work.
strings.에, 그동안 수고했다는 건…?: Huh? What do you mean by that...?
strings.여기로 계속 오느라 수고하셔서 나머지 두 개 패널은 동방 대륙에서 개방하: You've worked hard coming back here so often, so we've arranged for the last two panels to be opened in the eastern continent.
It's been a while. The alliance asked me to help you, so here I am.
Your ability is... remarkable, Asma... We will keep the book safe here...
strings.어, 책을 도서관에서 보관하면 어떻게 해석하나요? 아스마 씨는 루맨에 계: Wait. If the library keeps the book, how will you decipher it? You'll be staying in Lumen...
Hehe. I've read and memorized it all. I can take my time deciphering it.
She's as much of a genius as I am. An expert in history and an excellent mage...
strings.뭘요. 시스터들에게도 배운 게 있어서 도구 정화도 할 수 있어요!: Oh, please. I learned from the Sisters too, so I can purify the items as well!
These people are rather more shameless than I expected...
strings.이 마법서 꽤 재미있어요. 7대 초인 이전 세대 초인이라니…, 연구해 볼: This grimoire is fascinating. A Champion from before the Seven Great Champions... Well worth researching.
strings.마법사는 이스트랜드의 사람도, 프레이오스의 사람도 아닌 거 같아요. 말투: The mage seems to be from neither Eastland nor Freios. The manner of speech is different.
And the description mentions pale skin, silver hair, and purple eyes...
strings.(왠지 내가 알고 있는 사람하고 비슷한 것 같네.): (That sounds rather like someone I know.)
The mage told the boy to train where the Training Forest stands today.
At the time, no one had noticed that place's unusual energy. Yet the mage recognized it.
strings.거기서 혼자 수련하던 소년에게 무슨 일이 일어난 것 같지만, 그 내용이: Something seems to have happened to the boy while he trained alone there, but I don't know what.
It says his sword broke and he was badly wounded.
strings.그곳에 가봐야 할 것 같군요. 그러면 거기가 부유섬 맞죠?: I should go there. That's on the Floating Island, right?
strings.네. 맞아요. 그러면 절 찾아오세요. 전 항상 루맨에 있으니 헤매시면 안: Yes. Come find me afterward. I'm always in Lumen, so don't get lost! Oh, and you'll have to persuade Bilbradha. Understood?
Asma is as impatient as the adventurer... Gone already...
strings.책 속 소년 모습 말이야…. 그분하고 비슷하지 않아?: The boy in the book... Doesn't he resemble that person?
strings.연구해 볼 만한 가치가 있는 것 같아. 리즈, 도와줘. 그런데 우리가 괜: I think this is worth studying. Help me, Liz. But will we be all right?
Perhaps... We are here to do that sort of thing...
strings.여기에요, 여기. 모험가님. 오, 이게 그 도구군요. 처음 보는 건데,: Over here, Adventurer. Oh, so this is the item. I've never seen it before. It feels quite unusual.
strings.지스카드님이 예전에 글루아트를 쓰러뜨리고 찾았던 게 있었다는데, 혹시 저: I heard Lord Ziskad found something after defeating Gluart long ago. Perhaps it was that 'Tear of Light' you found earlier. I'm not certain...
strings.그런 이야기가 있군요. 그건 그렇고 연합에서 도와준다고 말씀해 주신 것: I see. About the alliance helping me... There's something I'm curious about.
You'd expect power connected to Champions to attract attention. Yet everything is quiet.
strings.이런 힘을 가지고 싶어 했던 울이 의외로 조용하고…. 제가 조용히 왔다: Even Ull, who wanted that kind of power, has been surprisingly quiet. And I'm not exactly discreet in my travels.
strings.유란님께서 조용히 처리해 주시는 것 같아요. 모험가님이 온전히 그 힘을: I believe Yuran is quietly taking care of things, so you can receive that power without interference.
Perhaps because you help Lady Iris with her work.
strings.(그 사람 속을 하나도 모르겠어.): (I can't understand that woman at all.)
strings.저는 부탁받은 일을 처리할 뿐이니까요. 그럼 마법서의 다음 내용을 알려드: I simply do what I'm asked. Now, I'll tell you the next part of the grimoire.
strings.이 마법사는 두려움을 베러 갈 곳이 있다면서 소년을 그곳으로 보내요. 모: The mage sends the boy somewhere to cut down his fear. It's a place you know well, Adventurer.
strings.한 번 가보시겠어요? 그곳에 가면 뭔가 있을지도요. 가는 김에 모험가님의: Will you go? You may find something there. Perhaps you could cut down your own fear while you're at it?
It feels almost as though the grimoire and panel want me to...
strings.패널이 지닌 힘이 주인으로 인정하는 과정이 아닐까요?: Perhaps this is how the panel's power acknowledges its master?
strings.가실 때 조심하세요. 아직도 그곳엔 모험가님한테 쓰러진 길드원들이 남아: Be careful. Some of the guild members you defeated still remain there.
They're hardly a threat. I'll be back.
strings.오셨어요? 별일 없어서 다행이에요. 그러고 보니 가지고 계신 도구가 바로: You're back. I'm glad nothing went wrong. And that must be the item you're holding.
strings.어둠이 가득한 거울. 오직 그림자만 보여주다니. 이 도구엔 불안하고 외로: A mirror filled with darkness, reflecting only shadows. It holds a mix of unease and loneliness, so intensely I can almost feel it myself.
strings.소년이 무척 힘들었었나. 그래도 자신의 두려움을 베었나 봐요. 그 감정을: The boy must have suffered greatly. Still, he seems to have cut down his fear, leaving those feelings behind there...
strings.소년은 왜 스스로 힘든 길을 간 걸까요?: Why did the boy choose such a difficult path?
strings.모험가님이 여행을 떠난 이유와 비슷하지 않을까요?: Perhaps for a reason like the one that led you to begin your journey?
Hmm. I don't know. There's no single right answer to the choices people make.
strings.좋은 말씀이네요. 방금 저희 학파가 자랑하는 마법석으로 정화를 모두 끝냈: Well said. I've just finished the purification with the magic stone our school is so proud of.
strings.정화가 모두 끝나서 다섯 번째 패널이 개방됐어요. 이제 얼마 남지 않았어: With purification complete, the fifth panel has opened. You're almost there. A little more effort, and they'll all be open.
strings.그러면 다음 이야기를 들려줄래요?: Will you tell me the next part, then?
strings.성격도 급하셔라. 네, 말씀드릴게요. 소년은 자신의 두려움을 베고 어떤: Impatient as ever. Of course. After cutting down his fear, the boy rose to a new level.
strings.또 다른 자신을 만나서 자신의 마음속에 갔다고 해요. 그곳에서 많은 정령: They say he met another self and entered his own mind. There he met many spirits, heard their stories, and...
strings.자신의 또 다른 불안한 감정이 모두를 저주해서 밖으로 나오고 싶어 했다고: Another anxious part of him wanted to curse everyone and escape into the world.
strings.그나저나 이 책에 나온 그대로라면 마음속으로 가야 한다는 건데, 그게 가: But if we follow the book, you would have to enter someone's mind. Is that even possible?
I'll be back. I'll deal with any spirits blocking the way too.
strings.네? 어떻게 가신다는 거예요? 아, 벌써 가셨네…. 저리 가시는 걸 보면: What? How will you get there? Oh, gone already... Heading straight off like that, have you been there before? What a remarkable person.
strings.정말 정령들이 있는 곳에 다녀오셨군요. 바로 정령의 날개를 구해오실 줄이: You really did visit a place of spirits. I never expected you to bring back the Spirit's Wing so quickly.
strings.사실 사념으로 만들어진 도구지만, 정말 아름답네요. 이렇게 패널이 반응하: It's actually an object formed from lingering thoughts, but it's beautiful. And the panel is responding...
It was more troublesome than I expected.
Then I'll tell you where to find the last item for the final panel.
strings.소년은 마음속을 헤매다 자신의 두려움을 건드는 원초적 존재와 만나게 됐대: While wandering within his mind, the boy encountered a primordial being that stirred his fear.
strings.…아마도 우리 세계의 존재는 아니었던 것 같아요. 그 존재를 만나 다시: ...It seems not to have belonged to our world. After meeting it, he returned to reality.
strings.(이 이야기도 분명 내가 알고 있는 이야기 같아….): (This definitely sounds like a story I know...)
Afterward, he was active as a Champion. That's all I know. Yet I feel there should be more...
I definitely read the whole book. I don't know why it feels that way.
strings.그러면 도서관으로 가야 하는 건가요?: Do I need to go back to the library, then?
strings.불편하셔도 그래야 할 것 같아요. 제가 따로 메시지를 보낼 테니, 마지막: I'm afraid so. I'll send a message separately. Once you've found the last item, go to the library.
The librarians may know what follows.
I will. I'll be off, then. Thank you for all your help.
You're back, Adventurer. Well done finding the last item.
A pearl holding terrible darkness... I sense magic almost too great to bear...
Fortunately, we can still purify it. If you'd been even a little later...
strings.정확하진 않지만, 모험가님이 다른 차원의 틈으로 빨려 들어갔을걸요?: I'm not certain, but you might have been sucked into a rift to another dimension.
strings.워어…. 아니, 그런 무서운 말을 눈 깜짝하지 않고 할 수 있는 거죠?: Whoa... How can you say something so terrifying without blinking?
...That is what the item you're holding is for.
A power that encompasses even time and space...
strings.이걸로 모든 패널이 개방됐어요. 힘이 느껴지시나요? 마법서와 오브 패널에: All the panels are open now. Can you feel the power? There's no magic left in the grimoire or Orb Panel.
strings.마법서는 앞으로 저희가 보관할 예정입니다…. 그리고 혹시 몰라 기술 설명: We will keep the grimoire here... And as a precaution, we made a separate book of the sections describing the techniques.
Here you are. It's not in the ancient language, so you should be able to read it.
Thank you. I'll put it to good use. I can train using this.
strings.아, 질문이 있어요. 혹시 그 소년이 그 뒤에 어떻게 됐는지 알 수 있을: Oh, one question. Do you know what happened to the boy afterward?
strings.그 부분에 대해선 저희도 놀랐어요. 다섯 번째 패널이 개방되면서 빈 페이: That surprised us too. When the fifth panel opened, writing began to appear on pages that had been blank!
strings.그럼 읽어드릴게요. 마법사는 소년의 성장에 감탄하며 훌륭한 자가 돼 대륙: Then I'll read it. 'Amazed by the boy's growth, the mage told him to become a worthy man and protect the continent, then vanished.'
strings.소년은 자신의 힘으로 어려운 사람을 돕고 정의롭게 행동한다. 거대한 악에: 'The boy used his power to help those in need and act justly. He took up his weapon and went to the battlefield to oppose a great evil... But...'
strings.다음에 어떻게 되는데, 그렇게 뜸을 들여요?: What happened next? Why the pause?
strings.소년은 전장에 갑자기 난입한 거대한 흰 이리에게 목을 물렸고, 그의 하얀: 'A vast white wolf suddenly entered the battlefield and bit the boy's throat. His white hair was stained with blood...' Oh, it ends here...
strings.다른 이야기는 없나요? 그게 끝인가요?: Is there nothing else? That's the end?
strings.이게…. 끝인 것 같군요. 이전 세대 초인인 소년의 이야기가 이렇게 끝일: This... seems to be the end. I didn't expect the story of a Champion from a previous age to end like this...
Liz, there's nothing we can do except research it and find out.
strings.나중에 진짜 초인을 만나야 제대로 된 이야기를 들을 수 있겠군요. 그럼: I'll have to meet an actual Champion someday to hear the full story. See you later, both of you.
strings.(갑자기 이상한 기분이 드는데…, 뭐지? 내가 초인이 된 것만 같은 그런: (I suddenly feel strange... What is this? As though I've become a Champion myself...)
You are not imagining it, Adventurer.
strings.하르모니아? 여긴 무슨 일이죠?: Harmonia? What are you doing here?
strings.저는 하르모니아가 아닙니다. 하르모니아가 제 메시지를 대신 전하기 위해: I am not Harmonia. She has come only to convey my message.
Only you can see Harmonia's form and hear her voice now, Adventurer.
strings.후후. 편의상 마법사라고 해둘까요?: Hehe. For convenience, shall we say I'm a mage?
strings.당신, 설마 그 마법사? 거의 천 년 전 사람 아닌가요? 아니, 어쩌면: Don't tell me you're that mage? Wouldn't you be nearly a thousand years old? Or perhaps a Champion... What do you want?
strings.어머, 의외로 빨리 평정을 찾는군요. 할 말…, 아니…. 부탁이 있어서: Oh, you regained your composure surprisingly quickly. I had something to say... no, a favor to ask, so I came before I fall asleep.
I know you're no ordinary person.
strings.그러면 빠르겠네요. 내 동생이 선택한 그 아이를 지켜주세요. 제 부탁은: Then this will be quick. Protect the child my younger sibling chose. That is my only request.
Your sibling? Chose? Which child? What are you talking about...?
Hehe. You needn't understand now. You will do it anyway.
strings.그리고 한 가지 일러줄게요. 초인의 서를 통해 얻은 이 힘은 당신의 앞날: And one more thing. The power you gained through the Book of Champions will open a new path in your future.
strings.하지만 다른 이들은 달라요. 당신의 힘을 시기하고 질투하겠죠. 부디 조심: But others will feel differently. They will envy your power. Be careful. It is a power my siblings left for the sake of the world.
strings.당신은 이제 새로운 힘으로 지금 일곱 명의 초인이 쓰는 기술을 사용할 수: With this new power, you can now use the techniques of the seven current Champions.
strings.지금은 흉내 내는 수준이겠지만, 수련을 꾸준히 하면 온전히 당신의 것처럼: For now, you may only imitate them. But with steady training, you will wield them as your own.
Then I hope we can meet properly before long, Adventurer...
strings.(시야에서 하르모니아의 모습과 마법사의 목소리가 사라졌다.): (Harmonia's image and the mage's voice disappear.)
strings.대체 누구지? 정령왕의 몸을 빌려서 나타난 거라면 보통 인물은 아니라는: Who could that be? Anyone who can appear through a spirit king's body is no ordinary being...
strings.혹시 세레스 여신과 같은 신일까…?: Could it be a god, like Goddess Seres...?
